title: THE GAMBLER WINDOW LINES ARE CENTRED
why: Seen on the 4K screenshot of 2026-10-07: in WIRT THE GAMBLER the credits line and Wirt line ran from the very left edge of the panel, touching its border, under a centred title and centred cards. They are centred like the rest of the window now; the words are unchanged.
now: The lines at the top of the gambler window are centred and clear of the frame.

edits.replacement:
#gamblemodal .msub, #gamblemodal .plist{ max-width:1060px; width:100%; }
  #gamblemodal .msub{ text-align:center; }   /* v16.xx, seen on the 4K screenshot (2026-10-07): the credits line and Wirt's line ran full width from the panel's left edge, flush against its border, under a centred title and centred cards; centred like them */
